title: Bounded right-fraction factorization
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with derived category $D(\mathcal A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and let $K,L$ be cochain complexes and $a,b\in\mathbf Z$. Suppose $K^n=0$ outside $[a,b]$ and $L^n=0$ for $n<a$. Every morphism $f:Q(K)\to Q(L)$ is represented by a roof $K\xleftarrow{s}M\xrightarrow{g}L$ in which $M^n=0$ outside $[a,b]$ and $Q(s)$ is an isomorphism.
